Markets.title: India bonds to stay hemmed in by oil, Treasury moves ahead of inflation data
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds are expected to remain range-bound due to fluctuating oil prices and rising U.S. yields while investors await key domestic inflation data. This upcoming economic data and a major bond auction are causing market caution regarding the Reserve Bank of India's future interest rate strategy.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks mixed as Nvidia turmoil hits AI-linked shares

Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The agency expects this growth rate to continue through 2028 due to strong domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience against energy shocks. However, the agency warned that inflationary pressures, a deficient monsoon, and rising El Niño risks could threaten future growth.
